findings.title: Reject incomplete direct-source manifests before changing turn indexing
findings.evidence: sources is considered present solely by JavaScript truthiness. An empty array switches line 151 to files[turn-1], but absent matching direct source still falls back to native.pilot.stage at line 158. A stage consumes one turn without publishing, while the next turn already advances to another file or FINAL.
static_reproduction: Use a valid TASK_CONTRACT with pilot_role='integration', files=['src/model.ts'], sources=[] and otherwise normal fixture inputs.
At request suffix .1, sources is truthy, path is files[0], no direct source exists, so only native.pilot.stage is proposed.
At suffix .2, path is files[1] (undefined), so line 152 returns FINAL even though no native.storage.write was proposed for src/model.ts.
findings.impact: A malformed or partial manifest can produce a successful Task result with missing publications. The final external checker may catch missing files, but the fixture should fail closed rather than declare its work complete.
findings.recommendation: Validate that a supplied direct manifest has exactly one complete authorized source per requested path before using direct-source indexing, or persist per-path stage/publication progress. Do not compare repaired analytics to the initial deliberately buggy template hash; bind the expected source to the trusted acknowledged version manifest.

findings.title: Consume the clarification answer before resuming code generation
findings.evidence: The code-cli role emits QUESTION at turn 1, then simply subtracts one from every later turn and continues staging/writing. This branch never finds or verifies the forwarded ANSWER text, answer source, or requirements_sha256.
static_reproduction: Run only the branch logic conceptually with code-cli turn suffix .1: it returns WAIT/QUESTION.
Resume at suffix .2 with no answer entry in context: turn is decremented to 1 and the normal file path/staging branch proceeds unchanged.
findings.impact: The current fixture can demonstrate Host-driven message delivery/resume, but cannot substantiate a claim that the coding role made its next decision from the clarification answer.
findings.recommendation: Require a provenance-bound ANSWER from the authorized resident/lead flow, validate its requirements hash against the original requirement source, and retain WAIT when absent or mismatched. Alternatively limit the acceptance wording to deterministic Host-controlled resumption.
